newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber, Pacific Bell sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber, Pacific Bell sign agreement.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Tuesday it entered into a local telecommunications interconnection agreement with Pacific Bell, a unit of Pacific Telesis Group.

The agreement will allow Brooks to begin providing local exchange services to residential and business customers throughout Pacific Bell's California service areas in San Jose, Sacramento, Stockton, Fresno, Bakersfield and San Mateo.
Brooks has 29 networks in 16 states in operation or under construction. It plans to have 30 networks by the end of 1996 and 50 by the end of 1998.
